doc: M2-FP-24: the Shell Shrine channels' curb collision (game/levels/ch03/shell_shrine/shrine_channel_curbs.gd). Kept out of shell_shrine.json because that file is one of the baked GI's inputs (tools/shrine/gi_inputs.py), and collision never changes the light. h and w: the trough's height and width (the kit's shrine_channel_straight, 0.3 m by 0.7 m); crossing_m: the open floor left at each trough's middle (a step across the water); min_m: the shortest curb built either side of it.
